title: Cannabidiol for Treatment-Resistant Epilepsy: A Systematic Review
abstract: Background: Cannabidiol (CBD) has been studied for treatment-resistant epilepsy. Methods: We systematically reviewed randomized controlled trials. Results: CBD showed reduction in seizure frequency compared to placebo in selected populations. Conclusions: Further standardized dosing studies are needed, especially in diverse healthcare settings including Brazil.

title: Industrial Hemp Fibers in Sustainable Textile Supply Chains
abstract: Hemp fibers offer low water footprint and high tensile strength for blended textiles. This review covers processing, quality grading, and market adoption in Europe and emerging markets.
